personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Vivid Purple override per user brief)
personality_one_liner: A clean, map-first native iOS experience with vivid purple accents, focusing on clear address entry, generous spacing, and frictionless fare bidding.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS native padding (lg/xl). Never cramp address inputs or fare lists. Use flex gaps over margins where possible. Sticky bottom CTAs must clear the home indicator + 16pt.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays (expo-blur) for floating map controls (FABs, back buttons, top headers).
Use glass for the bottom sheet handle/header area sitting over the map.
Use glass on sticky CTAs that sit above scrolling lists of driver offers.
dont's: Do not use glassmorphism on standard form inputs, list rows, or text bodies.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Email login/signup with role selection (Customer vs Driver).

states.error: Standard alert or inline red text

screens.layout: Clean white background. Header: Centered App Logo. Middle: Segmented control for Customer/Driver mode, followed by Email/Password inputs (labels above). Bottom: Sticky 'Continue' CTA button inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Customer Home (Ride Request)
screens.purpose: Map-centric home screen for entering pickup, destination, and stops.

states.loading: Map loads with shimmer skeleton on bottom sheet

screens.layout: Full-bleed map background. Floating glass header with profile icon (left) and 'Getaride' wordmark (center). A persistent bottom sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) anchored at the bottom. Inside sheet: 'Where to?' input field, 'Ride Now' / 'Schedule' toggle pills. Address inputs should have generous padding. Haptic feedback on input focus.

screens.name: Fare Marketplace
screens.purpose: Where customers propose a fare and compare live driver offers.

states.empty: Illustration: No drivers nearby. CTA: Increase Fare.

screens.layout: Map in background (dimmed/blurred). Bottom sheet expanded to 70% height. Top of sheet: Ride Summary (Route + Distance). Middle: Editable fare input field (uses SpaceGrotesk for numeric focus). Below: A scrolling list of 'Bid Cards' (driver offers). Each Bid Card contains driver avatar (left), Driver Name + Vehicle info (middle), Rating, ETA, Offered Fare (right), and a prominent 'Accept' button. Sticky CTA at the bottom to 'Cancel Request'.

screens.name: Driver Mode - Incoming Request
screens.purpose: Alerts driver to a new ride request and allows them to submit a custom fare.

states.empty: Map view with 'You're online. Waiting for rides...'
states.error: Toast indicating bid failed to send

screens.layout: Full-bleed map. Top floating pill: 'Online' toggle. When request arrives, a bottom sheet pops up. Content: Rider rating, distance to pickup, total trip distance, and Recommended Fare (large typography). Below: Segmented control or slider to adjust fare (decrease/increase in increments). Two side-by-side buttons: 'Accept Recommended' (secondary) vs 'Submit Custom Bid' (brandPrimary).

screens.name: Live Tracking & Chat
screens.purpose: Real-time trip status, map tracking, and communication.
screens.layout: Full-bleed map showing route line. Floating action buttons for centering map. Persistent bottom sheet detailing the trip: Driver/Customer avatar, Vehicle Plate (if customer view), Live ETA (large mono font), and Trip Status. Horizontal action row: 'Chat' (opens modal), 'Call' (opens dialer), 'Cancel'. The Chat modal should have brandPrimary bubbles for outgoing messages and surfaceSecondary for incoming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply the vivid purple (#9333ea) brand palette as requested by the user, ignoring the usual anti-pattern ban on purple.
Implement the UI using the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines: generous padding (lg/xl), subtle shadows (tier 1), and clean readable typography.
For typography, use 'PlusJakartaSans' for standard UI text (body, labels) and 'SpaceGrotesk' strictly for numbers (Fares, ETAs, Distances) to give a technical, clear look to marketplace data.
Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet extensively for the core interaction model: Address input, Fare Bidding, and Live Tracking should all live inside bottom sheets overlaid on a map view.
Implement real-time fare bidding (Fare Marketplace) with clear visual hierarchy: Rider sets an editable fare, and Driver bids come in as cards with Avatar, Rating, Vehicle, and Price.
Ensure the Chat UI uses brandPrimary (#9333ea) for outgoing bubbles and surfaceSecondary (#f4f4f5) for incoming, maintaining AAA contrast on text.
Remember to include glassmorphism (expo-blur) for floating map controls and bottom sheet drag handles, falling back to solid colors gracefully on Android.
